title: רבי אביתר

paragraphs: Rabbi Evyatar sent to Rav Chisda; Elijah spoke with him. Rabbi Yonatan was his colleague (see there). The Holy One, blessed be He, said, “Evyatar My son says thus,” concerning the concubine at Gibeah, Gittin 6b. G.N. writes: Rabbi Evyatar and Rabbi Yonatan are in the mystery of ‘man, concubine’ [איש פלגש] and its repair; they came to reveal the transgression. See there, letter pe.
